# Creational Pattern Skills

- [Factory Method](../factory-method/SKILL.md): Define a creation operation through an abstraction while allowing concrete implementations to decide which product type is instantiated.
- [Abstract Factory](../abstract-factory/SKILL.md): Create families of related or compatible objects without coupling clients to their concrete classes.
- [Builder](../builder/SKILL.md): Construct complex objects step by step while separating construction from the final representation.
- [Prototype](../prototype/SKILL.md): Create new objects by copying an existing prototype instead of depending on its concrete construction details.
- [Singleton](../singleton/SKILL.md): Ensure a type has one process-wide instance and expose a controlled access point to it.
